skill.summary: Interact with Anki flashcard decks via the AnkiConnect REST API. Use when the user wants to create, update, search, or manage Anki cards, decks, notes, or models.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of anki-connect-skill.
- Enables interaction with Anki flashcard decks via the AnkiConnect REST API.
- Supports creating, updating, searching, and managing Anki cards, decks, notes, and models.
- Requires Anki running with the AnkiConnect plugin installed.
